reproduce:
from quiverlab import Quiver, GF

Q = Quiver(vertices=[1], arrows={"x": (1, 1)})
A = Q.algebra(relations=['x*x*x'], field=GF(2))
M = A.module({1: 2}, {"x": [[0, 0], [1, 0]]}, side="right", name="M")
M.dimension_vector()
M.projective_resolution(3).dimension_vectors()
